title: contentDisposition leaves a hex-escape-like file name ambiguous
prompt: contentDisposition(filename) in index.js emits a simple 'attachment; filename="..."' header for any pure US-ASCII file name. But a file name that itself contains something that looks like a percent escape (for example 'hello%41world.txt') is ambiguous for clients that percent-decode the plain filename parameter, so the original name is not preserved. Such names need to be sent in a form that is not ambiguous, while ordinary ASCII names keep the simple form. Please fix it.
